en.headline: West Kowloon deficit widens to 998 million dollars
en.dek: The Authority said the 2025/26 operating shortfall grew by about 229 million dollars, mainly on preparations for the performing-arts centre.
body: The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority recorded a deficit of 998 million dollars in the 2025/26 financial year, about 229 million dollars more than the previous year, an increase of nearly 30 percent, RTHK reported.

The Authority said spending rose because it had to prepare for the coming West Kowloon Performing Arts Centre, cover a wider range of operations and a growing number of visitors, and improve facilities management and digital systems.

A paper from the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau to the Legislative Council put basic operating income at 856 million dollars, broadly in line with 871 million dollars the year before. The Authority said income excluding interest rose from 645 million to 768 million dollars, and that the overall cost-recovery rate excluding interest rose from 37 percent to 40 percent.

It forecast that total operating deficits for 2024/25 to 2026/27 would stay within the ceiling set by the government. The Authority said it is preparing a tender for the first residential project in Zone 2B, expected in the first half of next year, and is also preparing a tender for a hotel, commercial and cultural-creative complex next to West Kowloon Station in Zone 2A.

zh.headline: 西九管理局赤字擴大至9.98億元
zh.dek: 管理局稱2025/26年度赤字較上一財年多約2.29億元，主因是西九演藝中心開幕前的前期準備。
body: 西九文化區管理局2025/26財政年度赤字為9.98億元，較對上一個財政年度增加約2.29億元，赤字擴大近三成。香港電台引述管理局的說法報道。
管理局解釋，過去一年須為即將開幕的西九演藝中心做前期準備，應付擴大的業務範圍和持續增加的訪客人數，亦要提升設施管理和數碼科技應用，令營運開支增加。
文化體育及旅遊局向立法會提交的文件指出，該年度基本營運收入為8.56億元，與上一年度的8.71億元大致相若。管理局表示，撇除利息後的收入由6.45億元增至7.68億元，整體成本回收率由37%升至40%。
管理局預測，2024/25至2026/27三個財政年度的總營運赤字可控制在政府所定上限之內。管理局正準備西九2B區首個住宅項目招標，預計明年上半年進行，並正準備毗鄰高鐵西九龍站、屬2A區的酒店、商業及文創綜合發展項目招標。
